protocol.budget: K disjoint windows of <= 150 lines; K in [1, 2, 3, 5]
protocol.metric: gold-hunk line recall on pre-patch (old-side) hunk ranges; plus gold-file recall

pools.gold: gold files + package __init__, oracle seed file (P6.74 protocol)
pools.repo: all non-test source .py in snapshot, no seed

protocol.embed: dense retrieval over AST def/class chunks (first 80 lines) + per-file header chunk (lines 1-60), max_length=512, cosine to issue; window anchored 35 lines above chunk start
protocol.callgraph: BM25 top window seed, BFS 2 hops over name-resolved call edges (callee+caller), names with >5 defs dropped, BM25 back-fill
protocol.ast_only: function/class nodes ranked by node-level BM25; window anchored 35 lines above def; no edges
protocol.oracle: max coverage of gold lines with K disjoint 150-line windows (exact enumeration over undominated candidates; greedy if intractable)
protocol.known_leak_in_gold_pool: ASTHorizonGraph.localize branches on len(other_py)>=1, which equals multi-file topology only when the pool is gold-only
